newsitem.title: USA: Conrail shares soar on view deal is near.
newsitem.headline: Conrail shares soar on view deal is near.

text.p: Shares of Conrail Inc rose sharply in early trading on reports that a four-month takeover battle for control of the railroad could soon end with a transaction valuing it at $10.5 billion, or $115 per share.
"It would be good for everybody involved. Everybody would walk away happy," said one takeover trader.
Conrail and CSX Corp have agreed to merge in a $9.4 billion cash and stock transaction, but that agreement has been challenged by rival bidder Norfolk Southern Corp, which has bid $10.5 billion.
The Conrail-CSX agreement has been stymied since January, when Conrail shareholders rejected a critical measure that would have permitted the transaction to move forward.
Since then, the three companies have been trying to negotiate an end to the stalemate.

Sources familiar with the situation told Reuters on Sunday that negotiations to end the takeover fight have attained momentum and it increasingly appears a negotiated deal will be struck among the three parties.
The likely deal, which is still in delicate stages of negotiations, would call for Conrail's assets to be split between CSX and Norfolk Southern, they said.
Norfolk Southern repeatedly has said any negotiated deal must value Conrail at $115 per share.
Shares of CSX rose 3-1/4 to 49-3/8 and Norfolk Southern gained 2-5/8 to 93-3/4.
